item.title: Investigators say a money trail ultimately exposed Manchester City's financial schemes
item.description: The alleged scheming that allowed Manchester City to circumvent European soccer's financial fair-play rules was both sophisticated and, at its core, as simple as it gets

item.title: Sean McVay says NFL agrees officials erred on pass interference that swung Rams' loss to Broncos
item.description: Rams coach Sean McVay says the NFL told him officials made a mistake in calling a late pass-interference penalty that swung Los Angeles’ loss at Denver

item.title: Hegseth announces a new drone command and cuts to 20% of generals in 'State of the Force' speech
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is announcing some major changes to the U.S. military in what he calls his “State of the Force” address

item.title: 'Verity' puts Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett in a steamy Colleen Hoover thriller
item.description: Anne Hathaway stars in “Verity,” a psychological thriller where trust is elusive

item.title: No longer a secret, Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes doc 'You Can See Everything' lands in New York
item.description: No longer a secret, “You Can See Everything,” Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary, has premiered at the New York Film Festival

item.title: Woman accused of firing at home of Rihanna indicted on attempted murder with assault weapon
item.description: A Florida woman has been indicted for allegedly firing a rifle at the California home of Rihanna and A$AP Rocky

item.title: A timeline of developments in AI safety since the attack on Hugging Face
item.description: Since OpenAI disclosed this summer that its artificial intelligence system hacked into another AI company in what is now referred to as the Hugging Face incident, other AI companies have jumped on the bandwagon with their own concerning events, such as hacking or runaway bots seemingly evading human control

item.title: Pandora opens $150 million Vietnam jewelry factory powered by renewable energy
item.description: Pandora has opened the world’s largest fine-jewelry crafting facility in Vietnam, powered entirely by renewable electricity and using 100% recycled gold and silver

item.title: Fed watchdog finds no crimes in $2.4B building renovation, only mismanagement
item.description: The Federal Reserve’s internal watchdog says that the central bank has broadly mismanaged an expansive building renovation project but did not find any criminal violations, as alleged by Trump administration prosecutors

item.title: Takeaways from AP investigation into collapse of housing towers during Venezuela's earthquakes
item.description: The collapse of public housing in Venezuela's La Guaira state after two June earthquakes is linked to decisions made in 2010

item.title: A Bulgarian soccer club president is shot dead at his home
item.description: The president of a top-flight Bulgarian soccer club has been shot dead in Plovdiv

item.title: Investigators work to determine why a pilot apparently tried to crash a FlyDubai flight to Israel
item.description: Investigators across the region are trying to learn why an Omani copilot stabbed his captain on a FlyDubai flight to Israel

item.title: A Russian drone hits a Kyiv school as Moscow presses its aerial campaign against Ukraine
item.description: A Russian drone has struck a school in Kyiv as the Ukrainian capital endured another day of relentless aerial attacks in the 4 1/2-year-old full-scale invasion by Moscow

item.title: Tokyo court grants legal protection to human voices in AI clone case
item.description: A Tokyo court has awarded legal protection for the human voice in a landmark case involving a popular Japanese anime voice actor

item.title: Pilot stabs fellow pilot on flight to Israel before passengers intervene to stop attack
item.description: Passengers on a plane from Dubai to Tel Aviv say they wrestled with a pilot who stabbed the other pilot as the plane dove sharply before making an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia
